name: attention_bf16_partial_v1
hypothesis: For the specialized full-context q_len=8 verify path only, store per-split value partial vectors in BF16 scratch instead of FP32. Keep score max/sum statistics, online softmax, merge accumulation, and final norm/gate in FP32. This halves split-partial write/read traffic while preserving FP8 KV inputs and reference output tolerance. Other kernels/routes unchanged.
decision_reason: Official H200 check passed all 16 tests but scored 1.87799x (95% CI [1.84982, 1.91123]), below the promoted 1.88401x. Verify-16 was slightly faster while verify-32 regressed; reject the all-batch BF16 scratch route and leave canonical attention unchanged.
